#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le "$n" ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

# Get the cutoff date (7 days ago)
cutoff_date=$(date -d "7 days ago" +%Y-%m-%d)
current_date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

total_sum=0

for file in log_files/log_server_*_*.txt; do
    # Extract server ID and date from filename
    # Format: log_server_X_YYYY-MM-DD.txt
    basename=$(basename "$file")
    server_id=$(echo "$basename" | sed -n 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_\([0-9-]*\)\.txt/\1/p')
    file_date=$(echo "$basename" | sed -n 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_\([0-9-]*\)\.txt/\2/p')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if is_prime "$server_id"; then
        # Check if file date is within last 7 days
        if [[ "$file_date" >= "$cutoff_date" && "$file_date" <= "$current_date" ]]; then
            # Sum integers in the file
            file_sum=$(awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}' "$file")
            total_sum=$((total_sum + file_sum))
        fi
    fi
done

echo "$total_sum"
EOF
chmod +x solve.sh
bash solve.sh
